title: Consolidate agent workflow surface and automate session boundaries
summary: Prioritize a smaller direct agent workflow surface that removes deprecated aliases/catalogs and makes new_session/context_refresh boundaries agent-owned instead of user-command driven.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki exposes a smaller direct workflow surface and required session/context boundaries are handled by the agent/adapter without asking the user to paste or press Enter on internal compatibility commands.
acceptance: `codewiki_claim` is not registered and callers use `codewiki_artifact_status` directly.
Static application tool catalog source is removed; the skill-facing catalog remains the documented tool map.
Deleted alias/catalog files are absent from package smoke and active docs.
Artifact-status coordination tests cover mark/read-overlap/conflict/release without the claim alias.
Active system docs and roadmap no longer instruct preserving wrapper aliases as the migration policy.
Session-boundary flow does not present /wiki-session-handoff or equivalent compatibility commands as normal user work for required boundaries.
Where Pi/adapter APIs can execute a boundary automatically, CodeWiki does so from agent-owned control flow and restarts from CodeWiki refs.

Where host APIs cannot execute a boundary from tool context, CodeWiki records an explicit platform limitation/fallback with next safe action instead of asking the user to press Enter as a routine step.
Workflow-efficiency evidence records user-interrupt/manual-command impact for the session-boundary path and keeps validation/task-close/publication proof gates intact.
Focused smoke tests cover automatic/no-user-command behavior and unsupported fallback semantics.
non_goals: Do not remove real application use-case services that still orchestrate IO, mutation, rebuild, or validation.
Do not refactor `src/application/claims.ts` into domain in this slice; keep runtime coordination behavior stable while removing the public alias.
Do not reopen TASK-006 role-worktree/publisher proof semantics except where session-boundary UX/tool surface needs stale-reference cleanup.
Do not implement full decision_build compiler in this task.
Do not weaken fresh-context/content-proof requirements for validation, task-close, publication, publish, or release.
Do not promise true new terminal/tab/process creation when Pi does not expose it; use explicit external-orchestrator/worker fallback language when needed.
Do not make completion-report generation the primary deliverable; keep it as follow-on unless small integration is needed for efficiency evidence.
verification: Run tests/smoke/session-handoff.test.mjs and related claim/wait smoke tests.
Run CodeWiki audits: alignment, changed, stale-reference, file-structure, generated-parity.
Validate implementation from fresh CodeWiki refs with checked content proof.

delta.desired: Deprecated tool aliases and dead application catalog are gone; replacement surfaces are direct; required new_session/context_refresh boundaries are agent-owned and no routine user command/Enter is needed.
delta.current: Claim alias/catalog cleanup is in progress, but session-boundary flow still has compatibility-command/editor-prefill/platform-fallback friction that feels slower than plain agent coding.
